notes.title: Wildland is back under the Gates of Siberia brand!
notes.content: [p]After much torment with choosing the concept and setting of the game, we decided to make a new Wildland! But since we got ourselves a publisher and registered the trademark "Gates of Siberia" in their name, the new part of the game will be released under this trademark.[/p][p][/p][p]In the new game, we want to fix and improve what, in the opinion of the players and ourselves, needed to be improved in the original Wildland. [/p][p][/p][p]In addition, the setting has also undergone significant changes, but references to our first game will, of course, be there. [/p][p][/p][p]In general, keep your finger on the pulse, it will be more interesting![/p]
